channels_note: Mention it from the feed you already post on. Same bot, same catalog, same answer — the channel only changes where the reply lands.
chains_note: Name a chain in the mention and the launch is routed there. If a route cannot complete, it says so before a single lamport is spent.

roadmap.title: Launch Anywhere
items: One mention creates a token paired to a real asset — live on Solana mainnet
Your coin trades against NVIDIA, the S&P or gold instead of against SOL
80/20 creator split written into the launch transaction itself
Around a dollar a launch, measured on real launches

roadmap.title: The agent that gets it
items: Say it however you say it — any language, any wording, typos included
Wrong ticker comes back as a question, never as a silent substitution
Discord, Telegram and X; Reddit, Instagram and TikTok in final testing
Name the chain and it launches there — Solana, Robinhood Chain, BNB

roadmap.title: Trade from the same thread
items: Buy and sell your coin by replying — no wallet app, no DEX tab
Price, holders and the curve come back in the reply, live
Alerts you set in words: tell me when it doubles, tell me when it graduates
Works for any coin on the launchpad, not only the ones you made

roadmap.title: Every coin gets a page
items: A page per coin at pairoo.xyz/coin/<address> — pair, fees and the curve, read live from the chain
Go live on it: reply `live <link>` and your YouTube, Twitch or Kick stream plays on your coin's page (TikTok and X open in a card — they forbid embedding)
On Robinhood Chain this is the only page a coin has: no explorer, no venue on Pons
Next: holders, fees earned and every payout, linked to the transaction that paid it

roadmap.title: Coins that did not exist before
items: Pair against a basket, not one name: NVIDIA, gold and the S&P in a single coin
Community launches — a server launches together and splits the cost
Schedule a launch and let the mention go out when you want it to
Pick a theme and the agent proposes the basket, the name and the art

roadmap.title: Pairoo anywhere
items: A Telegram mini-app: the whole launcher, no bot syntax to learn
A public API and SDK — run the same launch path inside your own product
White-label: your community, your name, our rails
New pairs the day the asset is tokenized, wherever it is tokenized
